verdict.rationale: Whether an authenticator's client code is open source is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack says Microsoft Authenticator's source is published or community-reviewable. The only open-source mention is a user recommending the alternative app Aegis, which reads as a contrast rather than support.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the client apps are open source, so the code handling my seeds can be inspected and community-reviewed
